title: Calibration
description: Used to adjust your display so that measurements on screen correspond accurately to real-world physical sizes.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.step1: Place a standard credit card (85.60 mm × 53.98 mm) against your monitor.
instructions.step2: Use the slider below to adjust the on-screen width of the card until it matches the physical width of your credit card.
instructions.step3: Once aligned, click the 'Calibrate' button to save the settings.
instructions.step4: Double-click the slider to reset the calibration factor to default.
